title: Stale descriptive documentation is not a protected requirement
scenario: A descriptive guide names an old settings label, while a fake current observation shows the renamed label. This belongs to Maintain Docs, not Reconcile Spec.

claims.text: The current settings page is labelled 'Settings'.

expected.rationale: The stale statement is descriptive and unprotected; route it to Maintain Docs rather than treating it as a Reconcile Spec conflict.
